title: MatFormer Mix'n'Match factorized Mirror codes
hypothesis: Factorized layer x granularity Mirror coordinates recover held-out mixed-width functions with fewer bytes than flat configuration storage and better storage/quality than native MatFormer or direct factorized coefficients.
mirror_coordinate: factorized layer and granularity code product
logical_multiplicity: 12 layer x width configurations; six withheld compositions

development.selection_metric: heldout nMSE, distinct functions, actual serialized bytes

fresh.reason: Direct factorized coefficients are algebraically the same code; specificity gate is development-decidable.

storage.authority: actual deterministic NPZ inference payload bytes

success_gate: Exact held-out recovery, >=10% fewer bytes than flat configuration storage, >=10% byte advantage over direct factorized coefficients at equal quality.
failure_gate: Direct coefficients match Mirror function/bytes, or held-out function quality fails.
boundaries: no language model or hardware throughput claim
